gw_host.advice.cert: It is not being renewed. Tip: the “Site” section of the panel or item 19 of the SSH menu
gw_host.advice.cert_ip: Tip: the “IP certificate” section of the panel shows why the renewal failed
gw_host.advice.clock: With a wrong time TLS and Reality break. Tip: timedatectl set-ntp true (chrony or systemd-timesyncd)
gw_host.advice.conntrack: Tip: find out who opens thousands of connections, or raise net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max
gw_host.advice.cpu: This happens when there are more devices than the core handles. Tip: the AmneziaWG kernel module, move some users to another server, a plan with more cores
gw_host.advice.disk: Most often the logs grow. Tip: journalctl --vacuum-size=200M
gw_host.advice.drops: Usually the provider’s network is overloaded. Tip: contact the provider
gw_host.advice.fd: Usually it is thousands of connections. Tip: raise LimitNOFILE of the service
gw_host.advice.inodes: Usually it is millions of small cache or log files
gw_host.advice.iowait: Tip: check whether the logs write too much and whether memory goes to swap
gw_host.advice.listen: The panel or xray is overloaded. Tip: check who opens so many connections
gw_host.advice.load: There are twice as many processes waiting for the CPU as cores. Tip: as with a busy CPU — the AmneziaWG kernel module or a plan with more cores
gw_host.advice.loss: The VPN will keep dropping. Tip: a ticket to the provider with this text
gw_host.advice.mem: Tip: the AmneziaWG kernel module instead of userspace, a plan with 2 GB of memory or more
gw_host.advice.nic_err: This is the provider’s network. Tip: a ticket to the provider with this text
gw_host.advice.oom: If it is your own program, raise its limit
gw_host.advice.oom_svc: Kaskad sets this limit. If it happens again, take a plan with more memory
gw_host.advice.oom_svc_any: Which service the limit stopped is in the kernel log: journalctl -k -g oom
gw_host.advice.oom_svc_other: If it is your own program or container, raise its limit
gw_host.advice.port: The server’s port is almost full — users may run short of speed. Tip: a plan with a wider port, or move some users to another server
gw_host.advice.psi_cpu: Tip: the AmneziaWG kernel module, move some users to another server, a plan with more cores
gw_host.advice.psi_io: Tip: check whether the logs write too much and whether memory goes to swap
gw_host.advice.psi_mem: Tip: the AmneziaWG kernel module instead of userspace, a plan with 2 GB of memory or more
gw_host.advice.retrans: Packets get lost between the server and users. Tip: if it lasts, a ticket to the provider with this text
gw_host.advice.rtt: Tip: if it lasts, a ticket to the provider with this text
gw_host.advice.softnet: Tip: the AmneziaWG kernel module, a plan with more cores
gw_host.advice.steal: The provider sold the core to several clients. Tip: contact the provider or take a plan with a dedicated core
gw_host.check.steal: Other virtual machines on the host (steal)
gw_host.event.probes_hint: You can turn on light network probes: every ≈ 30 s the server sends 3 ping packets to the points {addrs}; this shows the loss and the response time of the hosting network. To turn them on — item 22 of the SSH menu or kaskadctl host set --probes on
